# devops-cli — GitHub Copilot Instructions

> **This file is a pointer, not the source.** GitHub Copilot looks specifically for
> `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, so this stub exists to redirect it. [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)
> holds the rules for every task and routes each task to the document that owns it. Read
> that file. `devops ai agents` regenerates this stub and leaves an existing AGENTS.md alone
> unless `--force` is given; do not duplicate content here.
